tvShow.name: NCIS: Tony & Ziva
tvShow.overview: When his security company is attacked, Tony and Ziva must go on the run across Europe, try to figure out who is after them and maybe even learn to trust each other again so that they can finally have their unconventional happily ever after.

episodes.name: No Country Is Safe
episodes.overview: Their family now in danger, Tony and Ziva must find who is behind a nefarious cyber-attack.

episodes.name: No Friend of Mine
episodes.overview: Tony and Ziva track down the elusive hacker, only to join forces when Interpol closes in.

episodes.name: Cover Story
episodes.overview: Unsure who to trust and framed for a terrorist bombing, Tony and Ziva go off the grid.

episodes.name: Wedding Crashers
episodes.overview: Tony and Ziva use a wedding as an undercover operation to root out their enemies.

episodes.name: To Be Determined
episodes.overview: The Missing secretary General of Interpol leads Tony and Ziva to a high security prison.

episodes.name: We've Got Company
episodes.overview: The stakes grow even higher when the safe house Tali has been hiding in is compromised.

episodes.name: Dark Mirror
episodes.overview: Tony and Ziva return to Paris on a mission to spy on the double agents who are framing them.

episodes.name: Fire Sale
episodes.overview: Connecting the dots to a high-tech weapons manufacturer puts Tony and Ziva in the crosshairs.

episodes.name: Ride or Die
episodes.overview: With the enemy in sight and everything on the line, Tony and Ziva must face all their fears.

episodes.name: Full Circle
episodes.overview: To stop a deadly international attack, Tony and Ziva risk it all and learn who they can really trust.

reviews.author: chaw00
reviews.content: You can honestly pass on this one. The story is only average, the acting feels limited, and the serie is far too long. Many scenes drag on forever and focus on pointless details. Even watching at 1.5x or 2x speed feels painful. It’s a real waste, because there was potential at the start. A few roles and actors manage to lift the level a bit, but it’s clearly not enough to save the serie.
